lessons.title: Tajriba va natija: I have finished
lessons.goal: Present Perfect zamonini o'zlashtirasiz: have/has + 3-shakl, ever / never / just / already / yet.

frame.name: Present Perfect: have / has + V3
frame.formula:
I have finished the report.
She has changed her job.
Have you ever been to London?
I haven't seen him today.
frame.explain: Present Perfect o'tmishdagi ishning hozirgi natijasini ko'rsatadi: I have lost my keys — kalitlarimni yo'qotdim (va hozir ular yo'q). Tuzilishi: have / has + fe'lning 3-shakli. Aniq o'tgan vaqt aytilsa (yesterday, in 2020), Past Simple ishlatiladi.
table: Have you ever been...? / I've never...
I've just done it. / Not yet.

short: Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
Yes, she has. / No, she hasn't.

examples.en: I have finished the report, so we can start the meeting.
examples.uz: Hisobotni tugatdim, yig'ilishni boshlashimiz mumkin.

examples.en: She has changed her job twice this year.
examples.uz: U bu yil ikki marta ishini o'zgartirdi.

examples.en: Have you ever made a big mistake at work?
examples.uz: Ishda katta xato qilganmisiz?

examples.en: We haven't solved this problem yet, but we have found a few solutions.
examples.uz: Bu muammoni hali hal qilmadik, lekin bir nechta yechim topdik.

examples.en: He has already written his exam and he is happy with the result.
examples.uz: U imtihonini allaqachon yozgan va natijadan mamnun.

examples.en: My sister has never had a chance to study abroad.
examples.uz: Singlim hech qachon chet elda o'qish imkoniga ega bo'lmagan.

examples.en: I have learned a lot from my failures — experience is the best teacher.
examples.uz: Muvaffaqiyatsizliklarimdan ko'p narsa o'rgandim — tajriba eng yaxshi ustoz.

examples.en: They have worked on this project for six months and have made real progress.
examples.uz: Ular bu loyiha ustida olti oy ishladilar va haqiqiy yutuqqa erishdilar.

street.title: Tajriba haqida
street.note: "I've just finished" — juda yaqinda tugadi; "Not yet" — hali emas; "already" — allaqachon (kutilganidan erta).

lines.en: Have you ever worked in a big company?
Yes, I have. I worked there for three years.
lines.uz: Ha. U yerda uch yil ishladim.

lines.en: Have you finished your new project?
Not yet. We have made good progress, but we haven't tested it.
lines.uz: Hali yo'q. Yaxshi yutuqqa erishdik, lekin sinovdan o'tkazmadik.

lines.en: What is the biggest problem?
Time. We haven't had enough time since Monday.
lines.uz: Vaqt. Dushanbadan beri yetarli vaqtimiz bo'lmadi.

substitution.prompt: ___ you ever been to London? (Have / Has)
substitution.answer: Have you ever been to London?
We haven't solved this problem yet.

substitution.prompt: He ___ already written the test. (have / has)
substitution.answer: He has already written the test.

translate.en: Have you ever made a big mistake at work?
We haven't solved the problem yet.

fix.why: aniq o'tgan vaqt bilan Past Simple

lessons.tip: Present Perfect — aniq vaqt aytilmaydi, natija muhim. Aniq vaqt bo'lsa (yesterday, in 2020, two days ago) — Past Simple: I saw him yesterday.

lessons.title: Majburiyat: must, have to, mustn't
lessons.goal: Majburiyat va taqiqni ifodalashni o'rganasiz: must, have to, don't have to, mustn't.

frame.name: must / have to / mustn't
frame.formula:
You must wear a helmet.
I have to finish this today.
You don't have to come early.
You mustn't smoke here.
frame.explain: must — kuchli majburiyat yoki qoida; have to — tashqi sababga ko'ra majburiyat; don't have to — shart emas; mustn't — qat'iyan mumkin emas. Oxirgi ikkisini aralashtirmang: ma'nosi butunlay boshqa!

aff: She has to wear a uniform.
neg: She doesn't have to wear a uniform.
q: Does she have to wear a uniform?
short: Yes, you must. / No, you don't have to.
Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.

examples.en: You must read the safety rules before you start work.
examples.uz: Ishni boshlashdan oldin xavfsizlik qoidalarini o'qishingiz shart.

examples.en: I have to finish this report before the deadline.
examples.uz: Bu hisobotni muddatgacha tugatishim kerak.

examples.en: You don't have to sign every page — only the last one.
examples.uz: Har bir betga imzo chekishingiz shart emas — faqat oxirgisiga.

examples.en: Passengers mustn't smoke inside the building.
examples.uz: Yo'lovchilar bino ichida chekishlari mumkin emas.

examples.en: She has to provide her documents and a copy of her licence.
examples.uz: U hujjatlarini va litsenziyasining nusxasini taqdim etishi kerak.

examples.en: Do I have to pay tax on this bonus?
examples.uz: Bu bonusdan soliq to'lashim kerakmi?

examples.en: The agreement says that the company must pay the salary on the first day of the month.
examples.uz: Shartnomada aytilishicha, kompaniya maoshni oyning birinchi kunida to'lashi shart.

examples.en: He didn't have to work at the weekend, so he rested.
examples.uz: U dam olish kunlari ishlashi shart emas edi, shuning uchun dam oldi.

street.title: Qoidalar
street.note: "Is it allowed?" — ruxsat so'rashning qisqa shakli; rasmiy joylarda "Am I allowed to ...?" deb ham aytiladi.

lines.en: Do I have to fill in this form?
Yes, and you must sign at the bottom.
lines.uz: Ha, va pastda imzo chekishingiz shart.

lines.en: Do I need a copy of my passport?
You don't have to bring it today, but you must show it at the interview.
lines.uz: Bugun olib kelishingiz shart emas, lekin suhbatda ko'rsatishingiz shart.

lines.en: Is there a deadline?
Yes, the contract must be ready by Friday.
lines.uz: Ha, shartnoma jumagacha tayyor bo'lishi kerak.

substitution.answer: She has to wear a uniform.
You don't have to come early.

translate.en: I have to finish this report.

fix.wrong: She have to wear a uniform.
fix.right: She has to wear a uniform.

lessons.tip: mustn't va don't have to — butunlay boshqa ma'no: mustn't = taqiq (mumkin emas), don't have to = shart emas (xohlasang qil).

lessons.title: Maslahat: You should rest / I gotta go
lessons.goal: Maslahat berishni o'rganasiz (should / shouldn't) va so'zlashuvdagi "gotta" shaklini o'zlashtirasiz.

frame.name: should / shouldn't + gotta
frame.formula:
You should sleep more.
You shouldn't work so much.
I've gotta go now.
You don't gotta worry.
frame.explain: should — maslahat ("kerak, yaxshi bo'lardi"), shouldn't — maslahat bermaslik. So'zlashuvda esa gotta = have got to (majburiyat) ishlatiladi: I gotta go — ketishim kerak. Don't gotta = shart emas.

short: Yes, you should. / No, you shouldn't.

examples.en: You should sleep seven or eight hours — it's a healthy habit.
examples.uz: Yetti-sakkiz soat uxlashingiz kerak — bu sog'lom odat.

examples.en: You shouldn't drink so much coffee; it gives you stress and takes your energy.
examples.uz: Ko'p qahva ichmasligingiz kerak; bu stress beradi va energiyangizni oladi.

examples.en: What should I do to keep a balance between work and rest?
examples.uz: Ish va dam o'rtasida muvozanat saqlash uchun nima qilishim kerak?

examples.en: You should do some training every week and focus on one step at a time.
examples.uz: Har hafta mashq qilishingiz va bir vaqtda bir qadamga e'tibor berishingiz kerak.

examples.en: I've gotta go now — my bus leaves in five minutes.
examples.uz: Hozir ketishim kerak — avtobusim besh daqiqadan keyin jo'naydi.

examples.en: You don't gotta worry about the price; the quality is more important.
examples.uz: Narx haqida tashvishlanishingiz shart emas; sifat muhimroq.

examples.en: He should pay attention to the details — small mistakes can cause big damage.
examples.uz: U tafsilotlarga e'tibor berishi kerak — kichik xatolar katta zarar keltirishi mumkin.

examples.en: Why don't you ask your manager for advice?
examples.uz: Nega menejeringizdan maslahat so'ramaysiz?

street.title: Maslahat
street.note: "You'd better ..." — "should" dan kuchliroq maslahat: You'd better see a doctor — "shifokorga ko'rinsangiz yaxshi bo'ladi".

lines.en: I'm always tired and stressed.
You should change your routine. How many hours do you sleep?
lines.uz: Tartibingizni o'zgartirishingiz kerak. Necha soat uxlaysiz?

lines.en: About five.
That's the problem. You should sleep more and take short breaks.
lines.uz: Muammo shu. Ko'proq uxlashingiz va qisqa tanaffuslar qilishingiz kerak.

lines.en: I've gotta finish a big project this week.
lines.uz: Bu hafta katta loyihani tugatishim kerak.

lines.en: Then you shouldn't skip lunch. It gives you energy.
lines.uz: Unda tushlikni o'tkazib yubormang. Bu sizga energiya beradi.

lessons.tip: should, must, can dan keyin fe'l o'zak shaklda — to ham, -s ham qo'shilmaydi. "You should to rest" — eng ko'p uchraydigan xatolardan biri.

lessons.title: Sonlar va narx: How much is it?
lessons.goal: 1 dan 20 gacha sanashni, narx so'rashni va miqdorni aytishni o'rganasiz.

frame.name: Sonlar va narx
frame.formula:
How much is it?   — It's twenty thousand.
How many do you need?   — A pair.
Two and a half hours.
A quarter past five.
frame.explain: Sonlar ingliz tilida 1 dan 12 gacha alohida so'z, 13–19 esa -teen qo'shimchasi bilan yasaladi. Narx so'rashda How much is it? (birlik) yoki How much are they? (ko'plik) ishlatiladi.

examples.en: How much is this bag? — It's two hundred thousand.
examples.uz: Bu sumka qancha? — Ikki yuz ming.

examples.en: I need three kilos of potatoes and a pair of shoes.
examples.uz: Menga uch kilo kartoshka va bir juft tufli kerak.

examples.en: The meeting starts at a quarter past nine.
examples.uz: Yig'ilish to'qqizdan chorak o'tganda boshlanadi.

examples.en: We waited for an hour and a half.
examples.uz: Biz bir yarim soat kutdik.

examples.en: There are twenty students in the class, and seventeen of them are girls.
examples.uz: Sinfda yigirma talaba bor, ulardan o'n yettisi qiz.

examples.en: Eleven and four is fifteen.
examples.uz: O'n bir va to'rt — o'n besh.

examples.en: The number is on the ticket — check it, please.
examples.uz: Raqam chiptada — iltimos, tekshiring.

examples.en: Zero is a number, but we don't count from zero in this game.
examples.uz: Nol ham son, lekin bu o'yinda noldan sanamaymiz.

street.title: Narx so'rash
street.note: "I'll take it" — "olaman" (xarid qilishga rozilik); "I'll think about it" — "o'ylab ko'raman" (muloyim rad).

lines.en: How much is this jacket?
Four hundred and fifty thousand.
That's a bit expensive. Can I get a discount?
I can give you ten percent off.
OK, I'll take it. And I need two pairs of socks.
lines.uz: Mayli, olaman. Va ikki juft paypoq kerak.

lines.en: That's another thirty thousand.

translate.en: I need two pairs of socks.
The meeting is at a quarter past nine.

lessons.tip: Narx so'rashda How much is it? — birlik, How much are they? — ko'plik. Sanash uchun How many ...? ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Savol so'zlari: what, who, where, why
lessons.goal: To'g'ri savol berishni o'rganasiz: so'roq so'zi + yordamchi fe'l + tartib. Til o'rganish lug'ati.

frame.name: Savol so'zlari
frame.formula:
What is your name?
Where do you live?
Why did you come?
Who is that man?
How many words do you know?
frame.explain: Savol tartibi: so'roq so'zi + yordamchi fe'l + ega + fe'l. Istisno: who ega bo'lsa, yordamchi fe'l kerak emas — Who opened the door? (kim eshikni ochdi?).

neg: This word doesn't have two meanings.
The lesson doesn't begin at nine.

examples.en: What does this word mean? — I don't know the meaning, look in the dictionary.
examples.uz: Bu so'z nima degani? — Ma'nosini bilmayman, lug'atdan qara.

examples.en: Where is the mistake in this sentence?
examples.uz: Bu gapda xato qayerda?

examples.en: How many new words do you learn every lesson?
examples.uz: Har darsda qancha yangi so'z o'rganasiz?

examples.en: Why is the spelling different?
examples.uz: Nega yozilishi boshqacha?

examples.en: When did you start learning this language?
examples.uz: Bu tilni qachon o'rganishni boshladingiz?

examples.en: Who wrote this text?
examples.uz: Bu matnni kim yozgan?

examples.en: How much time do you need for the translation of this page?
examples.uz: Bu betning tarjimasi uchun qancha vaqt kerak?

examples.en: Which topic is the most difficult for you?
examples.uz: Qaysi mavzu siz uchun eng qiyin?

street.title: Tushunmay qolganda

items.en: I don't know how to say it.

street.note: "What's the word for ...?" — o'zbekcha so'zning inglizchasi nima ekanini so'rashning eng tabiiy usuli.

lines.en: Excuse me, what does "deadline" mean?
It's the last day or time when you must finish something.
lines.uz: Bu biror narsani tugatishingiz shart bo'lgan oxirgi kun yoki vaqt.

lines.en: How do you spell it?
D-E-A-D-L-I-N-E.
Thank you. And which page has the example?
Page twenty-two, in the second dialogue.

substitution.answer: How many words do you know?
Why did you come so late?

translate.en: Where is the mistake in this sentence?
How do you spell this word?
